method: Soak the raw rice, parboiled rice, toor dal, and chana dal together for 1 hour.
Separately soak a handful of moong dal and urad dal to be added whole later.
Grind the soaked rice and main dals coarsely with red chilies, asafoetida, and salt.
Add the separately soaked moong dal, urad dal, and chopped coconut pieces to the batter.
Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Deep fry ladles of batter in hot oil until crunchy and golden brown.
notes: Note: Makes about 50 vadas. Serve with chutney.
